blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) will impose a moratorium on road excavations from Nov. 1 until midnight on Dec. 23. The moratorium aims to limit road disruptions during preparations for the upcoming 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit scheduled for Nov. 16-18 and the Christmas season. MMDA Chair Don Artes said the agency had directed the parties concerned to suspend roadworks unless absolutely necessary. The directive also covers areas outside the summit’s event zones, as roadworks there could affect traffic flow. “We have also issued marching orders to hold off on roadworks unless absolutely necessary, […]...
